# appsignal_log_action_order (Resource)

The order in which an app's log actions (filters, metrics and log triggers) run. The listed actions run first, in this order; the rest follow in their current order. The filter AppSignal adds for a metrics action with `drop_lines` stays right behind that action. Use one per app; destroying it leaves the order as it is.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Drop health checks before they are counted or alerted on.
resource "appsignal_log_action_order" "web" {
  app_id = appsignal_app.web.id
  action_ids = [
    appsignal_log_filter.health_checks.id,
    appsignal_log_metric.jobs.id,
    appsignal_log_trigger.import_errors.id,
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action_ids` (List of String) Ids of appsignal_log_filter, appsignal_log_metric and appsignal_log_trigger resources.
- `app_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The app id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import appsignal_log_action_order.web <app_id>
```
